### Observed differences

In the later window, among traces containing activity A21, the distribution of its outgoing transitions shifted: the share going to A20 increased from about 19% to 46%, while the share going to A19 decreased from about 51% to 26%; the share to A25 remained similar (30% to 28%). These percentages are based on 43 traces before and 50 traces after. [DIR001]

### Inference

Support level: Insufficient evidence

The evidence is insufficient to infer a change in the process. Only one control-flow item was observed, while the screening expects 0.23 items by chance alone; this is within the range an unchanged process typically produces, so the observed shift in A21's outgoing transitions cannot be distinguished from random variation.
